learning_objective: 🎯 Let us learn about India's amazing space adventure and the brave rocket that went to the moon!

main_concepts.simple_explanation: Chandrayaan is a very special and powerful machine built by the smart scientists in our lovely country, India.
It flew very fast, high up into the sky, zooming past the clouds, and travelled very far to reach the silvery moon.
Chandrayaan safely landed on the moon and sent us beautiful pictures of space. It made all of India very proud and happy!

fun_activity.title: 🚀 Build a Rocket
fun_activity.instructions: Use an empty paper roll and some bright coloured paper to build your very own toy space rocket. Give your rocket a cool name!

quick_recap: ⭐ Chandrayaan is a very special and brave spacecraft from India.
⭐ It travelled super fast and very far to explore the moon.
⭐ Our smart scientists worked very hard to make it a big success for everyone.
